sunTitle.zh: 远处看着小，本身没有缩小
sunTitle.en: Smaller in the sky, not in space

typesTitle.en: Large does not always mean massive

orbitsTitle.en: Neither star is pinned at the center

sunContext.zh: 保持同一颗太阳 · 改变观察距离

typesContext.zh: 代表性模型 · 不是一颗星的连续成长录像
typesContext.en: REPRESENTATIVE MODELS · NOT ONE STAR GROWING

orbitsContext.zh: 共同质心 · 质量与距离相互对应

distance.zh: 观察距离 · 对数刻度

ratio.zh: B 星质量 / A 星质量
ratio.en: Mass of B / mass of A

phase.zh: 轨道相位 · 拖动定位，播放持续绕行
phase.en: Orbital phase · seek, then keep orbiting

sunScale.zh: 左右采用同一初始视角基准，右图只缩小视大小。极小时十字定位符不是太阳直径；光晕和背景星点不用于测量。
sunScale.en: Both panels share the initial angular scale; only the right apparent disk shrinks. A crosshair marks subpixel disks, not their diameter. Halos and background points are not measurements.

typeScale.zh: 两颗主星盘共用线性直径比例；太阳过小时用十字定位，另附明确放大的辨认图。标尺以太阳直径为单位。切换型号时视野会重新取景；800 倍模型另带 50 倍红巨星作中间参照。均为取整教学模型，不是具体恒星的测量值。
typeScale.en: The main disks share a linear diameter scale. A crosshair locates a subpixel Sun; a labeled inset enlarges it separately. Rulers use solar diameters. Selecting a type reframes the view; the 800× model also includes a 50× red giant as an intermediate reference. These are rounded teaching models, not measured individual stars.

sectionScale.zh: 剖面各层厚度、颜色经过示意化；它不是内部照片，也不能从图上量出真实深度。
sectionScale.en: Layer thicknesses and colors are schematic, not interior photographs or measured depths.

orbitScale.zh: 点的位置和质量共享质心构造；星盘大小与间距分开缩放。没有碰撞、潮汐、质量转移或长期稳定性求解。
orbitScale.en: Positions and masses share one barycentric construction; disk sizes and separations use separate scales. Collisions, tides, mass transfer and long-term stability are not solved.

sunExplain.zh: 把右边的观察者移远，角直径减小，光走得更久，单位面积收到的能量也减少。太阳仍是同一颗星。它由核心核聚变供能，不是靠氧气燃烧的火球。
sunExplain.en: Move the right-hand observer away: the angular disk shrinks, light takes longer, and less energy arrives per unit area. The Sun itself is unchanged. Core nuclear fusion supplies its energy, not chemical burning with oxygen.

sunBoundary.zh: 光行时为真空中距离除以光速；通量按无吸收的平方反比计算。这里不模拟飞船，也不计算核心能量传到表面所需的时间。不要直接观看真实太阳。
sunBoundary.en: Vacuum light travel is distance divided by light speed; flux assumes no absorption and follows an inverse-square law. This is not spacecraft motion or the time for core energy to reach the surface. Never look directly at the real Sun.

orbitExplain.zh: 两颗星都绕共同质心运动。质量较大的星离质心更近；改变质量比，看两条轨道怎样分配同一间距。三星模式先把近双星作为内层，再让第三颗星绕这个整体运动。
orbitExplain.en: Both stars orbit their shared center of mass. The heavier star lies nearer that center; changing the mass ratio redistributes the same separation. In triple mode, a close inner pair and a more distant third star form a hierarchy.

orbitBoundary.zh: 三星不是三颗星必然乱跑。这里是两组圆轨道的层级教学构造，不是自由三体积分，也不证明任意三星都稳定；三体问题中的物体也不一定是恒星。
orbitBoundary.en: Three stars do not inevitably move chaotically. This is a hierarchical construction from two circular orbits, not a free three-body integration or proof of stability. Bodies in a three-body problem need not be stars.

enlargedSun.zh: 太阳辨认图 · 单独放大

surfaceNote.zh: 表面颗粒缓慢变形、亮暗变化与暗斑转动为增强对比的光球示意；独立于轨道播放，速度和细节未按真实恒星标定，也不是观测照片。真实太阳在太空中呈近白色，不同恒星的表面细节并不相同。
surfaceNote.en: Slowly evolving granules, brightness changes and rotating dark regions illustrate a photosphere with enhanced contrast. Surface activity is independent of orbital playback; timing and detail are not calibrated to real stars or observed maps. The real Sun looks nearly white in space, and other star types have different surfaces.

description.zh: 这个低质量主序星模型比太阳小，也更冷、更暗。它的内部可大范围对流；不能把太阳的每一层直接套用到所有恒星。
description.en: This low-mass main-sequence model is smaller, cooler and dimmer than the Sun. Convection can span much of its interior; not every star has the Sun’s layering.

description.zh: 太阳仍在核心把氢聚变成氦。向外输送能量的方式不同：辐射区主要传递辐射能量，外部对流区还有等离子体的循环运动。
description.en: The Sun fuses hydrogen to helium in its core. Radiation transports energy through the radiative zone; circulating plasma also transports energy in the outer convective zone.

description.zh: 核心氢耗尽后，某些恒星的外层会大幅膨胀，而质量并没有按体积同比增加。这个红巨星模型有致密氦核、周围的氢燃烧壳层和疏松包层；不是所有红巨星都处于同一阶段。
description.en: After core hydrogen is exhausted, some stars expand enormously without a proportional increase in mass. This red-giant model has a compact helium core, a hydrogen-burning shell and an extended envelope; not all red giants share the same evolutionary stage.

description.zh: 大质量恒星也可能发展出非常膨胀的外层。这个模型半径是太阳的 800 倍，质量却是 15 倍。后期内部燃烧层随演化改变，这里只区分膨胀包层与致密内部，不编造固定的洋葱层。
description.en: A massive star can also develop an enormously extended envelope. This model has 800 solar radii but 15 solar masses. Burning layers change during late evolution; the cutaway only distinguishes the envelope from the compact interior, not a fixed onion-layer structure.
